items.quote: It’s their inner game. The same applies in sales. Your beliefs about yourself shape your performance even more than your sales knowledge.
items.statement: Your beliefs about yourself shape your performance even more than your sales knowledge.

items.quote: So while improving your sales skills is crucial, true success comes from mastering your inner world—your beliefs about yourself, your consistency, your daily habits.

items.quote: If you believe you can only earn or sell a certain amount, you'll unconsciously seek out prospects who reflect that belief.
items.statement: You’ll only do the activities that match that level of belief.
